description.en: A self-hosted email relay with webhooks, reusable templates, and delivery insights.
description.zh: 可自行托管的邮件中继，支持 Webhook、邮件模板与用量查看。

source.description: Self-hosted email relay with webhook triggers, templates, and usage dashboard

subject.en: Original violet and teal faceted dove with pink blossoms
subject.zh: 保留原图的紫青色碎片化鸽子与粉色花枝

description.en: The dove, shoulder curve, watchful eye, and surrounding blossom group retain their original layout. This pass does not use any superseded neck-extension study.
description.zh: 鸽子、肩部曲线、专注眼神与周围花枝均保留原来布局，不采用此前已撤回的延长颈部版本。

description.en: Violet, blue, and mint facets remain the original bird; the existing pink blossoms form the signature accent group. All foreground pixels and detached petals are preserved.
description.zh: 紫、蓝和薄荷色碎片构成原来的鸟，既有粉色花枝是标志性的点缀组。所有前景像素与飘落花瓣均保留。

title.zh: 紫色纸面上的花瓣压纹

description.en: Sparse elongated petals sit at the corners of a muted violet field. Fine grain, offset edge light, and a shallow shadow keep the real blossom group in front.
description.zh: 稀疏修长的花瓣纹位于柔和紫色底面的角落，细颗粒、偏移边光与浅阴影让真正的花枝点缀保持在视觉前方。

sizeNote.en: The violet silhouette and pink blossom arc remain distinct at 32 px. At 16 px small petals and feather facets merge; use the transparent foreground for browser and sidebar marks.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时紫色轮廓与粉色花枝弧线仍能区分；16 像素时细花瓣与羽毛碎片会合并。浏览器和侧栏标记使用透明前景。
